metadata.title: BINGA — Software Engineer
metadata.description: I'm BINGA, a builder based in Syria. Software engineer and Framer creator focused on modern, scalable, conversion-driven web experiences.

about.intro: I'm BINGA, a builder based in Syria, currently working on Templyo, a platform for high-quality Framer templates.
about.description1: I'm a software engineer and Framer creator with a strong focus on building modern, scalable, and conversion-driven web experiences.
about.description2: Over the years, I've created and shipped multiple SaaS products and Framer templates used by global customers, helping them launch faster.

scrollReveal: From idea to launch. Clean, scalable digital products built to move fast, stay simple, and perform in real-world use, driven by clarity, structured systems, and intentional design.

items.quote: Templyo completely changed how I approach building sites in Framer. The templates are not just beautiful, they're actually structured in a way that makes scaling so much easier.
items.name: Yakoub Kashmiri

items.quote: I've tried dozens of Framer templates, but Templyo stands out. Everything feels intentional, from the layout to the smallest interactions.
items.name: Daniel K.

items.quote: Templyo saved me weeks of work. I was able to launch my landing page in a day, and it still looks fully custom.
items.name: Mark M.

items.quote: The quality is insane. Clean structure, smooth animations, and super easy to customize. It feels like a premium product from start to finish.
items.name: Omar H.
